newsitem.title: NORWAY: Tiger favours Aker, RGI merger.
newsitem.headline: Tiger favours Aker, RGI merger.

text.p: Tiger Funds of the United States now favours the planned merger between Norwegian investment group RGI ASA and offshore construction and building materials group Aker ASA, the Oslo Bourse said on Thursday.
It said Tiger and RGI had now agreed on the handling of Tiger's stake in Norway Seafoods, an RGI subsidiary.
News reports had said Tiger was demanding that RGI buy its shares in Norway Seafoods before RGI merged with Aker.

Under the agreement, Tiger can request that RGI buy up to 11.6 million shares that the fund holds in Norway Seafoods at 50 crowns per share between March 29 and November 30 next year, the brief statement said.
"All significant regulations in existing agreements with Tiger regarding restrictions on RGI's shares in Norway Seafoods...have been removed," the bourse said.
Aker and RGI shareholders will vote on the merger proposal on November 21.
The bourse said Tiger and RGI also agreed that Norway Seafoods be listed on the stock exchange next year.
